description.value:
For the Blademaster Specialist, a weapon is not a tool but an extension of the self. Years of obsessive practice erase the line between fighter and blade, until drawing a weapon, shifting stance, and striking true all happen as naturally as breathing.

This fluid mastery lets them abandon heavy armor entirely, trusting instead in speed and precision to keep them safe. In the heat of combat, a Blademaster reads the flow of battle and adapts on the fly, turning every exchange of blows into an opportunity to seize the advantage.
